match_keypoints_two_images: match keypoints between two images using the KeypointMatchingPipeline with a similarity threshold
match_keypoints_batch_images: match keypoints across a batch of image pairs using the KeypointMatchingPipeline and return per-pair results
validate_image_pairs: validate that input images are proper pairs of PIL Images or image path strings
run_keypoint_matching_pipeline: run the KeypointMatchingPipeline to find and rank matched keypoints between image pairs
postprocess_keypoint_matches: postprocess model outputs into sorted keypoint matches with coordinates and scores
